raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  version: "3.1.0"

package:
  name: pystemmer
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://pypi.org/packages/source/p/pystemmer/pystemmer-${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 083cc3ed90f4c3b0668f8e31c2925cbb4db3bf0fd6d710e0ad0914f33685f7df

build:
  number: 2
  script: ${{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv --no-deps --no-build-isolation

requirements:
  build:
    - if: build_platform != target_platform
      then:
        - python
        - cross-python_${{ target_platform }}
    - ${{ compiler('c') }}
    - ${{ stdlib('c') }}
  host:
    - pip
    - python
    - setuptools >=18.0
    - cython >=0.28.5
  run:
    - python

tests:
  - python:
      imports:
        - Stemmer
      pip_check: true

about:
  summary: Snowball stemming algorithms, for information retrieval
  license: MIT AND BSD-3-Clause
  license_file:
    - LICENSE
  homepage: https://github.com/snowballstem/pystemmer/

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - thewchan
